class.name: CubismBuildInfo
class.brief_description: Reports the native plugin's build and runtime versions.
class.description: Use these diagnostics when reporting compatibility problems. The build metadata records the selected SDK, Framework, Redot API, binding revision, platform, architecture, precision, and build target. Runtime values report the loaded Redot and Cubism Core versions.

method.name: get_debug_statistics
method.description: Returns main-thread diagnostic counters across live Cubism runtimes. Debug addons report resource ownership, CPU update time, vertex-buffer uploads and mask redraw requests for the process-frame interval identified by [code]frame_id[/code]. Release addons return only [code]{"enabled": false}[/code]. Timings measure CPU submission work, not GPU execution; ownership excludes resources retained only by callers after unload.

method.name: get_versions
method.description: Returns build metadata plus [code]runtime_redot[/code], [code]runtime_core_packed[/code], and [code]latest_moc_version[/code]. [code]addon_dirty[/code] indicates that the source checkout had local changes at build time. [code]sanitizer[/code] identifies the addon instrumentation mode. [code]framework_patches[/code] identifies reviewed build-copy patches and their source/helper hashes; the pinned SDK input remains unchanged. Dependency hashes identify the selected bytes; they do not certify platform or rendering compatibility.
